title: Private Shopping Tour from Minneapolis to Albertville Outlets
includes: Pick up and drop off at the Minneapolis
4 hours of free time for shopping and dining
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Comfortable Roundtrip Tour from your hotel in Minneapolis to Albertville Premium Outlets - plays host to luxury boutiques and stores selling everything from clothes and accessories to cosmetics and home essentials. Its world-class boutiques showcasing collections from prestigious local and international designers make for a truly memorable shopping experience. Add to all these a unbeatable prices, and a handful of trendy cafés and restaurants, and what you’ll get is one of the best shopping destinations in and around the Minneapolis. After you finish your shopping you will be picked up and will be delivered directly to your hotel in Minneapolis.

All our vehicles are fully licensed and insured. We are happy to provide child seats in our cars for all ages upon request. Vehicles are clean inside and outside; our drivers are well-dressed and unfailingly attentive to our guests. They speak English. They will greet you with a name sign and will help with luggage.
